The progress log and PR description both note "Twin-parity tests are red until then, by design" and "held for a third [claude-twin-sync]", so this is an acknowledged transitory state.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- `.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:27,172,245`; `.claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md:47` | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The live `.claude/commands/` files have not been updated to match the `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/` files, retaining old guidance that permits chaining between git commands and chained examples.
  WHY: CI run 36685610846 confirms failures in the twin-parity tests and `test_git_commands_run_unchained[live]`; sessions reading the live files do not receive the fix for the reported denial.
  TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "This project tells stage and fixer sessions to run the git commands the chain names exactly as written, unchained." The PR description frames this as the deliverable, and the plan repeats it under Goals and Implementation Steps.
  Expected change site: `.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md` Helpers intro (line 172), step 4 (line 27), checker prompt (line 245); and `.claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md` step 5 (line 47).
  Evidence of absence: the live `.claude/commands/` files have not been updated to match the `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/` files after the most recent `[claude-autofix]` commit (head `1618829e85d1`, last_run_diff shows the autofix edited only `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/{fix-claude-pr.md,implement-plan-claude.md}` plus the test and changelog — not the live `.claude/commands/` copies). Direct file reads confirm:
  - `.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:172` says "Run the git commands this command names (`git fetch`, `git checkout -B`, `git merge --no-edit`, `git push`) exactly as written too, with no `2>&1`, no pipe into `tail` or `head`, and no `;` or `&&` chain of `git status` or `git log` reads" — i.e., it only forbids chaining status/log reads, NOT chaining between git commands. The twin at `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:172` forbids both ("each as its own Bash call ... no `;` or `&&` chain, neither to another git command ... nor to `git status` or `git log` reads").
  - `.claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md:47` says "no chained `git status` or `git log` reads" — same omission. The twin at `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md:47` forbids the `;` / `&&` chain between git commands.
  - `.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:27` (step 4) still shows `git fetch origin claude/implement-plan-<slug> && git checkout -B claude/implement-plan-<slug>-phase-<n> origin/claude/implement-plan-<slug>` — a chained example. The twin splits these into two separate Bash calls.
  - `.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:245` (checker prompt) still shows `git fetch origin <HEAD, or <ref> for a source-revision run> && git checkout FETCH_HEAD -- .claude/scripts/check_in_status.py` — a chained example. The twin splits these.
  CI run 36685610846 confirms the gap empirically:
  - `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` failed; log shows `tests/test_check_in_session_targeting.py::test_twins_are_identical[fix-claude-pr.md]` and `test_twins_are_identical[implement-plan-claude.md]` failing with the diff between OLD and NEW wording at lines 47 and 172.
  - The new test `test_git_commands_run_unchained` (added in this PR at `tests/test_implement_issue_claude_command.py:129-145`) parametrizes on `(COMMANDS, TEMPLATE_COMMANDS)` — the `live` variant fails because the live copy still has the OLD wording and chained git code spans that the regex `r"`git [^`]*(?:&&|;)\s*git "` rejects.
  - `lint` aggregate fails because it requires every CI job's result to be `success`.
  The PR therefore ships an integration that, on merge, leaves main with the OLD, insufficient guidance in `.claude/commands/` (which is what every `/implement-plan-claude` and `/fix-claude-pr` session reads at runtime), and the NEW, sufficient guidance only in `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/` (which the consumer `@stable` sync reads). The defensive mechanism for this — the `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` job's twin-parity tests and the new `test_git_commands_run_unchained[live]` — is correctly red and blocking the merge. The `[claude-twin-sync]` that would copy the updated twins into the live `.claude/commands/` files has not landed (the log notes "third `[claude-twin-sync]` pending" at the time of the last commit). A reviewer autofix that updated the templates but not the live copies therefore leaves the PR in a state where the runtime defect #5293 records is NOT fixed; a future unattended session following the live guidance will still chain `git fetch` and `git merge` the same way and still be denied.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
